method: Hand count on fixtures/heldout. HH-HELD-01, 2026-06-15 America/Los_Angeles, 300-second intervals. Training on HH-TRAIN-01 selects 0.25 liters and 15 minutes because that is the longest persistence in the grid that still catches the 20-minute training leak and does not fire on the 10-minute shower or appliance cycle. Flow thresholds above 0.25 miss the 0.4 liter leak.
coverage_note: 288 expected slots minus the 11:30 local gap is 287 observed. 287/288 is above 0.90, so the household-day stays in the denominator. The gap is not inside either planted leak.
